|season = Fall |edibility = 10 |sellprice = 80 |xp = 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] |color = Purple }} The '''Wild Plum''' is a [[Fruits|fruit]] found via [[foraging]] throughout Stardew Valley in the [[Fall]].
